## What changes

## How it was tested

- [ ] Test written first and seen failing for the right reason (TDD)
- [ ] `bun run typecheck && bun test`
- [ ] `bun run build:native` (touched `native/`)
- [ ] `bun run check:snippets` (touched README or template docs)

<!-- What cannot be tested automatically: screenshot looked at, keys typed by hand,
performance numbers before and after (same scene, same session). -->

## Docs

- [ ] README / ARCHITECTURE / ROADMAP / AGENTS.md / template skills updated, or not needed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry (user-visible change)
